text: Astronomy is the study of the universe, which includes everything from the smallest particles to the largest galaxies. One of the most fascinating objects in the universe is a nebula, a cloud of dust and gas that forms stars and planets. To study these celestial bodies, astronomers use powerful telescopes to capture images of their vast, distant landscapes. Through these telescopes, we can see the beauty and complexity of the universe, and gain a better understanding of the fundamental laws that govern it.
